content: {"like":["Detail-oriented and values completeness (e.g., booklet inside, perfect condition, bonus content).","Quality-focused, preferring high disc quality and swift shipping.","Appreciates accessibility features such as closed-captioning and English captioning.","Enjoys well-presented items, evident from liking great wrapping.","Values classic and nostalgic items, as shown by liking amazing classic DVDs."],"dislike":["Dislikes missing or incomplete content (e.g., missing cover, missing episodes).","Strong preference for accessibility; dislikes lack of closed-captioning or English captioning.","Unacceptable when re-releases omit essential features for specific audiences.","Shows intolerance for omissions that affect user experience.","Prefers items that meet all stated criteria without compromise."]}
